dataset: CMU Eats / CMU Dining menu item extraction
primary_source: https://cmueats.com/ (ScottyLabs frontend/API) cross-checked against current CMU Dining listings
important_notes: This revision performs a deeper menu search: direct CMU 'View Menu' links, indexed CMU menu PDFs, current concept pages, and visual inspection of image-only PDF pages were used.
menu_coverage='full_or_near_full' does not always mean a Fall 2026-dated menu. Check menu_period/menu_status; older but detailed menus are explicitly labeled.
For recommendation/model ingestion, prefer full_or_near_full entries, then use partial entries only when their status is acceptable.
Prices are omitted from structured item lists even when present in the source.
Some current image-only CMU PDFs repeatedly failed remote rendering; those restaurants are kept partial and the exact failure is noted instead of guessing.
